name: ring alternate superman
description: A superman variation with your feet in rings, lifting opposite arm and leg in turn. It builds the lower back and core.
instructions: Put your feet in the rings and get into a face-down plank.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one arm forward while holding steady.
Return it and switch to the other arm.
Avoid letting your lower back sag.
Alternate sides for the full set.
